text:
The Nifty 50 closed at 25,299.35, up 0.18% on the day and 5.59% over the past five sessions, while the broader Nifty 500 rose 0.36% (5‑day gain 4.82%). Advances outpaced declines (294 vs 191), giving a breadth score of 75.1 and a “healthy” market tone. The Bank Nifty led the rally, up 1.19% to 61,518.5, its strongest five‑day move (10.02%). Volatility eased, with India VIX falling 5.37% to 16.62.

Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) were net buyers, adding ₹7,830.6 crore today and a five‑day total of ₹56,330.65 crore, while Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) sold ₹6,331.2 crore (five‑day net ‑₹38,351.5 crore). The leading sectors were PSU banks, capital markets, financial services, realty, private banks, auto and consumption. Options data show a put‑call ratio (PCR) of 0.85 for Nifty (bullish bias) with max‑pain at 25,200 and a call wall at 26,000; Bank Nifty’s PCR is 1.28 (slightly bearish) with max‑pain at 59,000 and a call wall at 60,500.

Watch the 25,276 point pivot (P) and the 25,166 point support (S1) on Nifty; a break below S1 could test the 24,000 put wall. For Bank Nifty, the 61,262 point pivot and 60,979 point support are key, with the 60,500 call wall offering resistance. Keep an eye on upcoming Q2 earnings (e.g., HAL, Oil India) and any rupee movement around the 94 per dollar level, as they may influence the next session’s direction.
